load_poseval_metric: load the poseval evaluation metric module using evaluate.load
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the poseval metric
run_poseval_evaluation: run the poseval metric to evaluate pose estimation predictions against ground truth
test_poseval_metric: test the poseval metric by loading it with evaluate.load and verifying it returns evaluation results
review_poseval_module: review the poseval metric module loaded via evaluate.load for pose estimation evaluation
